Standard: Actuators can withstand impulse pressures of 1.5X the normal pressure and burst pressure of 2.5X the normal pressure. Actuator pressure backlash and hysteresis do not exceed maximum of 1-degree deflection measured at the surface. Actuators internal and external leakage meet the allocation as specified by hydraulic system ICD. Actuator seals are designed to leak-before-burst. Actuators expected life operational cycles have been determined using operational usage profile. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Verify leak-before-burst design approach. Analysis.
  (1) Provide actuator backlash and hysteresis analysis to determine maximum surface deflection.
  (2) Provide analysis for actuator internal and external leakage. Test.
    (1) Lab test: Conduct actuator impulse pressure testing. Impulse pressure testing is to be done at both fully retracted and fully extended linear actuator position.
    (2) Lab test: Conduct actuator burst pressure testing.
    (3) Lab test: Conduct actuator duty cycle testing to verify a minimum of 25% cycles of full life profile. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
    (4) Lab test: Conduct actuator duty cycle testing to verify full life profile.
